fHeroTitle: Everything a screening needs, in one place
fHeroLead: Build an assessment for any role, run it under proctoring, and get a ranked shortlist your team can trust. Candidates get
fTakeawaysAnswer: CodeSpectra covers the whole screening: build a test for any role, run it under proctoring, and get a difficulty-weighted ranked shortlist with integrity flags beside each score.
fTakeaway1: Build: coding with hidden tests, MCQ, written and CAD questions in one assessment
fTakeaway2: Run: fullscreen lock, tab-switch and face-match proctoring, plagiarism checks
fTakeaway3: Decide: one ranked list, CSV export, released scores; plus hackathons and free practice for candidates
fBuildLead: Start from the role and experience band. Every question is weighted by difficulty and editable before it goes out.
fAnyRoleBody: Mix coding with hidden test cases, multiple choice, true or false, fill-in-the-blank, written answers and CAD design tasks in one test.
fPointsBody: Easy questions score 3, medium 4 and hard 5, so freshers and seniors are each assessed at the right level and still ranked fairly.
fCadBody: For mechanical and design roles: model a part, review a drawing.
fSmeBody: Send written and design answers to an expert reviewer for marking.
fRunLead: Invite candidates by email, send reminders, and let proctoring run for the whole session.
fProctorBody: Fullscreen lock, tab-switch detection, webcam face matching against the ID photo, copy-paste blocking and second-screen detection.
fTimedBody: Each invite opens a timed attempt with a visible countdown.
fHackathonBody: Teams of up to five join with one link, claim problems and submit a repository. Judges score each entry out of 100 on a shared rubric, then release results.
fDecideLead: Every candidate is scored the same way. Your team reviews a ranked shortlist instead of a pile of attempts.
fRankedBody: Candidates arrive ordered by points, with integrity flags beside each score.
fAiBody: Grade written answers in bulk with AI, then review and adjust before releasing scores.
fCsvBody: Download results for your own hiring tools.
fReleaseBody: Publish results to candidates when you’re ready.
fCandidatesLead: A free account gives candidates somewhere to prepare before test day, and somewhere to show what they can do after it.
fCodingBody: Problems and challenges with real test cases.
fMockBody: Timed practice tests in the same format as the real thing.
fCertsBody: Certificates for completed assessments that anyone can verify online.
fScannerBody: Scan your own projects and get AI-assisted fixes.
fFreeBody: Practise, take assessments you’re invited to, and keep your certificates in one place.
aHeroTitle: We help teams hire on proven skills
aHeroLead: CodeSpectra is a skills-assessment and hackathon platform for companies and colleges. It turns a long list of applicants into a
aHeroLeadEnd: backed by work each candidate actually did.
aOneLiner: CodeSpectra runs proctored, auto-scored skills assessments and ranks every candidate, so hiring teams review only the strongest.
aCategory: Skills assessment and technical hiring platform (SaaS).
aAudience1: Hiring teams and recruiters screening software, QA, CAD/engineering and graduate candidates
aAudience2: Colleges and training providers running campus assessments and hackathons
aAudience3: Candidates and students practising coding problems, mock tests and earning verifiable certificates (free)
aWhoMakesBody: AXISS Group, founded by Krishna Chintakayala. Offices in Hyderabad, India and Princeton, New Jersey.
aContentBody: Learn posts are written by our learning bot from cited sources, pass automated quality checks, and are reviewed, corrected or withdrawn by our team. See the
aWhyBody1: Résumés and keyword filters say little about whether someone can do the work. Interviews are expensive to spend on the wrong people. We built CodeSpectra so hiring teams can give every applicant the same practical test, then spend interview time on the strongest.
aWhyBody2: It started with coding assessments and grew to cover CAD and mechanical design, QA automation, aptitude and written answers, because most hiring isn’t only for developers.
aAxissBody: CodeSpectra is one of the products of AXISS Group, founded by Krishna Chintakayala, which builds hiring, education and workforce software for India and the US.
aPrinciple1Body: Every candidate in a screening is scored the same way, with harder questions worth more, so nobody is penalised for the level they were assessed at.
aPrinciple2Body: Proctoring logs events with timestamps instead of auto-rejecting people. A reviewer decides what a flag means.
aPrinciple3Body: Hiring for a plant, a design office or a test team deserves the same rigour as hiring developers.
aCtaTitle: Want to see it on one of your roles?
aCtaBody: We’ll set up a pilot assessment with you and show you the ranked shortlist.
qLead: Quick answers about assessments, proctoring, hackathons, billing and your data.
qStillBody: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Email our support team.
pSummaryFree: CodeSpectra has a free plan, and candidates always practise free.
pSummaryTeams: Hiring teams pay monthly or annually (annual saves about {pct}% on Pro), or agree a campus or company licence with sales.
